A '''battle''' occurred when the [[Ansarra Rebel base]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] base, came under attack by a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The attack occurred prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Destruction]] of the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]. The Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Freebooter]]'', piloted by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Devon Fuller]], also came under attack from the Imperial ship and was wrecked, though Fuller was able to escape. The Rebel Alliance would later loan [[Gender/Legends|him]] a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] named ''[[The Solar Flair]]'' so Fuller could continue to support their cause.<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle was mentioned in the [[1993]] reference book ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', published by [[West End Games]] for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="GG9" />
